title: My First Protest | Standup Comedy By Harshit Mahawar
description:
Unity is addictive.

No high matches the feeling of shouting slogans with thousands of strangers who suddenly stop feeling like strangers.

This stand-up comedy video is about my first protest at Jantar Mantar, where I witnessed thousands of Gen Z students protesting the NEET paper leak.

I expected a political rally.

Instead, I got one of the funniest, weirdest, and most hopeful weeks of my life.

There was tear gas.
There was Spider-Man.
There was Burger King.
There were internet shutdowns.
There were strangers sharing water.
And there was a school student named Raghav who reminded me why speaking up matters.

This isn’t a political speech.

It’s a story about Gen Z, unity, hope, humor, and what happens when ordinary people refuse to stay silent.

If you enjoy observational comedy, political satire, and stories that make you laugh before they make you think, subscribe. There’s more to come.

This video is dedicated to every student who stood at Jantar Mantar, shared their water bottles, and fought for their future.

Happy Independence Day! 🇮🇳

Hope it makes you smile.
And maybe leave you a little more hopeful.

Your friendly neighborhood comedian,
Harshit Mahawar
